title: Minnesota United signs Marcus Caldeira to one-year deal with options through 2029
text:

Minnesota United FC has signed forward Marcus Caldeira to a one-year contract that runs through 2026, with club options for the Sprint Season 2027, as well as the 2027-28 and 2028-29 seasons. The agreement is pending receipt of his P-1 Visa.
“We’re excited to welcome Marcus to our club and look forward to seeing him continue his development while adding depth and competition to our team this season,” said MNUFC Chief Soccer Officer and Sporting Director Khaled El-Ahmad.
“I am beyond grateful for the opportunity to join this ambitious club and take the next step in fulfilling my lifelong dream of playing professionally,” said forward Marcus Caldeira. “I can’t wait to get started and contribute to the continued success of this club, its supporters, and the incredible atmosphere that Allianz Field brings. I’m thankful for the trust and support shown from the club’s staff since draft day, and I am ready to get to work on leaving a lasting impact on the club.”
Caldeira was selected by Minnesota United with the 20th overall pick in the MLS SuperDraft 2024. He played collegiate soccer at West Virginia University starting in 2022, making 84 appearances (77 starts) and logging nearly 6,000 minutes. During his time there, he scored 42 goals and provided 15 assists.
In his senior year, Caldeira received several honors including Sun Belt Player of the Year and Sun Belt Offensive Player of the Year after leading his conference with 14 goals and seven assists. He also ranked fourth nationally with six game-winning goals that season. Other recognitions included All-Sun Belt First Team and Sun Belt Preseason Player of the Year.
During his first season at West Virginia in 2022, Caldeira appeared in 18 matches (15 starts), leading his team with five goals along with four assists. As a sophomore in 2023, he led the Sun Belt Conference with 12 goals—ranking him among national leaders—and earned spots on College Soccer News First-Team All-American, United Soccer Coaches Second-Team All-American, and All-Sun Belt First Team lists. In his junior campaign in 2024, he scored eleven goals earning All-Sun Belt Second Team honors.
Caldeira is originally from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada. Before college soccer at West Virginia University, he played for Forge FC in the Canadian Premier League as well as Sigma FC in League1 Ontario.
The official transaction states: Minnesota United signs forward Marcus Caldeira to a one-year contract through 2026, with club options for future seasons.
